Problem Statement:
Given a number n followed by n numbers Print the 2nd largest number in an array 
Input Description:
0<n<100
Given a number n
Followed by n number in next line 
Output Description:
Print the second largest number in an array 
Explanation:
6 is the size of the array
[5,7,4,4,6,8] Here 8 is first larger and 7 is next to it, so 7 is output. 
Sample Input:
6
5 7 4 4 6 8 
Sample Output:
7
